dedupe_keys.name: dhn scale benchmark generator of district heating network optimisation cases of increasing size

description: DHN-scale-benchmark is a small Python tool that generates synthetic district heating network optimisation cases of increasing size for benchmarking solvers and formulations. It was released on GitHub and Zenodo in December 2022 (version 1.0.0) by the GitHub user ywack for the first submission of a paper that was not yet linked. Running one script creates example heating networks for two benchmark cases, plots each network and exports a detailed Excel description of the graph. It is written in Python 3.11 with NumPy, Matplotlib and pandas. Coverage is synthetic networks not tied to a place. The code is accessible on GitHub and Zenodo under CC0 at no cost. Caveats: documentation is minimal and the related paper is not linked. Simulation uses are scaling tests of district heating design and operation optimisation models. Related records: model-topotherm-district-heating-network-design and data-district-heating-long-term-unit-commitment-instances also address district heating optimisation benchmarks.
